content.title: Alpha Pro Tech announces $2M expansion of share repurchase program
content.summary: Alpha Pro Tech (APT) announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a $2.0 million expansion of the Company’s existing share repurchase program. With this authorized expansion, the Company now has approximately $2.7 million available to repurchase shares of the Company’s common stock, $0.7 million of which remains from the previous expansion, most recently announced in December 2024.
